t: 瓦伦丁一世被封为罗马皇帝.
te: Valentinian I is proclaimed Roman Emperor.
dz: 瓦伦丁一世被封为罗马皇帝.
de: Valentinian I is proclaimed Roman Emperor.

t: 罗马皇帝瓦伦丁尼安 我任命他弟弟弗拉维乌斯·瓦伦斯为副市长.
te: Roman Emperor Valentinian I appoints his brother Flavius Valens co-emperor.
dz: 罗马皇帝瓦伦丁尼安 我任命他弟弟弗拉维乌斯·瓦伦斯为副市长.
de: Roman Emperor Valentinian I appoints his brother Flavius Valens co-emperor.
